entities.summary: King Wuling of Zhao, personal name Zhao Yong, was a ruler of the Zhao state. His reign was famous for one important event: the reforms consisting of "Wearing the Hu (styled) Attire and Shooting from Horseback " (胡服騎射). He was credited for the implementation of protective outfit during military events and proceedings.
